contract.dispatch: Decode a complete synthetic INTERACTION_CREATE envelope with Twilight GatewayEventDeserializer; pass the resulting Event through the actual VoiceResponder EventSink. No direct decide/summary helper calls supply the expected result.
contract.reads: Channel-only position, group and textchannels return the existing private summary for the selected saved creator. Alternating two creators preserves all whole rows and has exactly zero successful add_creator writes; the store has no configured write error, so attempted creator writes succeed and are counted.
contract.text: Cover custom name/extra role, off with retained configuration, default voice-chat with occupants/admins, and everyone visibility.
contract.saves: Side-only and number-only position edits, both group booleans, textchannels false, name-only and viewer-only edits save once, preserve unrelated fields and the other creator, and retain existing private summaries.
contract.refusals: Unknown creator and missing Manage Channels each reject read and edit packets for all three commands with existing exact copy, private responses, zero writes and unchanged rows. Permission-denial exact copy also excludes settings disclosure.
contract.oracle: Literal hand-checked baseline summary/refusal strings, explicit successful write counts, and full CreatorChannel equality. No expected response is derived from a production renderer.

expected_baseline.evidence: Local bounded-cache commands refused exit 75: no idle, below-budget slot; no per-worktree fallback. This is not behavioral RED and not a compile or control pass. Actual exact-head evidence belongs in the task handoff.
